title: Betagro Shop price-menu catalog
description: Stable product info. Changes rarely (new SKU, new photo). Prices live elsewhere (data/prices/).

sku.description: Our catalog key, e.g. PK-001. Unique. Never reuse a SKU for a different product.

sap_code.description: Betagro SAP code (รหัสอ้างอิง) as printed on the price sheet. Optional (eggs have none). Not unique: the sheet can list one code twice; the validator warns.

name_th.description: Thai name exactly as on the price sheet

description_th.description: Optional detail from the sheet's ลักษณะสินค้า column

unit.description: What one price is quoted per; prices[].qty_unit should match. tray = 30 eggs.

image.description: Product photo, normally assets/products/<SKU>.webp cut from the Betagro catalogue. An active, priced product whose image file is missing fails validation.

photo_match.description: How well the photo matches this product, judged by Thai name/cut only (catalogue codes are ignored): exact = same cut; close = same cut, different form or grade (sliced, skinless, trimmed); similar = no matching product in the catalogue, nearest same-category photo. Leave it out only while the image is a placeholder; an active, priced product without it fails validation.

active.description: false = hidden from the menu, history kept

placeholder.description: true = seed/demo item, replace with a real Betagro SKU
